summary.text: Helene Meister is the Republican candidate for Maryland State Senate District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was also the Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates in District 17 in 2022, when she finished fourth in a three-seat race with 7.9 percent of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Meister's campaign website, which describes the district as Rockville and Gaithersburg, says her campaign aims to bring practical solutions to reduce everyday costs for Maryland families.
It lists lowering energy bills by expanding in-state energy production among her priorities.
